title: Private Talks: Legal, Real Estate, Gifts
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened with the sole purpose of immediately transitioning into a closed-door executive session.
*   The private session was authorized to discuss specific matters including legal consultations, real estate deliberations, and considering potential gifts or donations.
*   No public action or vote occurred at this meeting; any final decisions resulting from the executive session were planned to be announced at a future public session.
